title: fix: stop speculative community monitor token alerts
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Stop flagging large prompt counts or cached tokens on unique probes; neither proves incorrect billing.
- Keep missing and internally inconsistent usage checks.
- Update the monitor prompt and cover the 235 prompt / 247 total case in the probe test.

Tests: `node --test operations/community-monitor/probe-schedule.test.mjs operations/community-monitor/chat-stream.test.mjs operations/community-monitor/image-probe.test.mjs`

gist.headline: Fewer false buzzes
gist.blurb: The community monitor has stopped mistaking big prompts and cached tokens for billing trouble. It still watches for usage data that is actually missing or does not add up.
gist.summary: Updated the community monitor to ignore large prompt-token and cached-token counts on unique probes, while retaining checks for missing or internally inconsistent usage data, including the 235 prompt / 247 total-token case.
gist.impact: Monitoring alerts should now focus on genuinely incomplete or contradictory billing usage reports instead of harmless token-count patterns.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden monitoring station where Polli, wearing tiny inspector glasses, calmly compares two token-count scrolls that add up correctly while a CRT monitor robot marks only genuinely mismatched records. The visual metaphor is a less-jumpy watchdog: large seed piles and cached jars are left alone, while missing or inconsistent ledger entries receive attention.
